title: Organize build artifacts by upload name
pr_body: Preserves client filenames under each build's artifact directory for easier browsing.
author: codex
provenance: Original synthetic production-style change authored for benchmark v2.

files.before:
from pathlib import Path
from uuid import UUID


def save_artifact(root: Path, build_id: UUID, name: str, content: bytes) -> Path:
    safe_name = Path(name).name
    target = root / str(build_id) / safe_name
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_bytes(content)
    return target

bugs.title: Upload filename can escape the build directory
bugs.rationale: The upload name is client-controlled and now retains ../ components. A name such as ../../config.json writes outside the build's artifact directory, potentially overwriting files writable by the service.
